S2.name: Sword Destroyer
S2.name_jp: ソード・デストロイア

descLevels.1:
(Passive Effect) At the start of the turn, removes <color=#28d9ed>1 debuff(s)</color> each from the ally with the lowest Health and from the caster.
Then grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>. The Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Max Health.

(Activation Effect) After being hit, uses <color=#28d9ed>Sword Destroyer</color> on the enemy with the highest Speed and has an <color=#28d9ed>80%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Taunted</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.
This skill's damage increases proportional to Max Health instead of Attack.
